CodeQL false positive (case ii). Source: `id.username.duplicate()` (line 310);
CodeQL's name heuristic treats the identity record `id` (which also holds
the password hash and code digests) as sensitive. The logged value is the
`username` field, labeled `public` in the frozen classification (command
`register`, argument `username`), i.e. allowed in the log by R7.2.
